character_anchors.prompt_summary: Caucasian male in his 30s with short black hair, thin-framed round glasses, and neat light stubble beard. He wears a clean fitted white button-up dress shirt. Sharp, observant eyes with a friendly, warm smile. Soft hand-drawn colored pencil illustration style with realistic proportions.

East Asian woman in her early 20s with long straight black hair and full straight bangs. She wears a soft light grey knit sweater. Delicate facial features with bright, expressive eyes. Soft colored pencil hand-drawn illustration style with warm texture.

location_anchors.prompt_summary: Modern glass curtain wall skyscraper with a distinctive slanted roof design. Surrounding environment includes lush green park lawns, wide paved urban avenues, and neighboring city buildings under a bright morning sky.

Spacious double-height building lobby featuring a geometric faceted terrazzo reception desk, slatted wooden ceiling grids, and soft vertical wall lights. The feature wall prominently displays the SYNERGY TOWER logo.

Sunlit modern presentation hall on the 13th floor with large floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking a panoramic city skyline. Rows of neat blue conference chairs face a clean white main wall mounted with a 3D INSAIT logo.
Bright, open-plan modern office space with natural daylight streaming through expansive windows. Features ergonomic office chairs, desktop computer monitors, and clean marble and wooden work desks.

prop_anchors.prompt_summary: 3D wall logo made of red and black volumetric block letters spelling INSAIT, mounted on a clean white wall with full black English institutional text centered below.
Red-and-white patterned paper food bag for Chinese shaobing pastry, neatly folded at the top, containing golden-crisp baked sesame shaobing.
